outgoingFlows.description: Dengue infection of humans via infectious mosquito bites.
Recovery from dengue infection and acquisition of post-infection immunity/protection.
Mosquito infection after biting infectious humans.
Mosquito death and replacement through vector turnover, returning the vector population to susceptibility in the aggregate model structure.

parameters.name: Vaccination coverage
parameters.description: Default routine vaccination coverage for 9-year-old children.

parameters.name: Catch-up campaign coverage
parameters.description: Coverage used for the optional one-off catch-up campaign in 10- to 17-year-olds.

parameters.name: Alternative vaccination ages
parameters.description: Age range explored in sensitivity analyses.

parameters.name: Transmission intensity (SP9)
parameters.description: Average proportion of 9-year-olds seropositive prior to vaccine introduction, used to characterize endemicity.

parameters.name: Time horizon after vaccination
parameters.description: Primary post-vaccination evaluation horizon for population impact and cost-effectiveness.

parameters.name: Trial simulation horizon
parameters.description: Simulation horizon for the Phase III trial comparison, including active and first year of passive follow-up.

parameters.name: Dose interval
parameters.description: Interval between vaccine doses in the three-dose schedule.

parameters.name: Discount rate
parameters.description: Discount rate applied to costs and health effects in the base-case economic analysis.

parameters.name: DALY cost threshold
parameters.description: Base-case threshold used to assess cost-effectiveness.

parameters.name: Symptomatic dengue DALY burden
parameters.description: DALYs incurred per symptomatic dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

parameters.name: Severe dengue DALY burden
parameters.description: DALYs incurred per severe dengue case.

parameters.name: Public payer cost, symptomatic case
parameters.description: Treatment cost per symptomatic dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

parameters.name: Public payer cost, hospitalised case
parameters.description: Treatment cost per hospitalised dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

parameters.name: Societal cost, symptomatic case
parameters.description: Societal cost per symptomatic dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

parameters.name: Societal cost, hospitalised case
parameters.description: Societal cost per hospitalised dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

parameters.name: Societal cost, fatal case
parameters.description: Societal cost per fatal dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

parameters.name: Probability of death among symptomatic dengue cases
parameters.description: Assumed probability of death for symptomatic dengue cases.
